## 8. Risk appetite and tolerance

Risk appetite is the aggregate level and type of risk the Group is willing to assume in pursuit of its strategy. It is the primary mechanism by which the Board constrains executive risk-taking, and it is expressed so that it can be measured, monitored and breached observably.

8.1 Structure ofthe appetite framework

| LAYER | SETBY | DESCRIPTION |
|---|---|---|
| Risk capacity | Board | The maximum risk the Group could absorb before viability is threatened, bounded by capital, liquidity and regulatory minima. |
| Risk appetite | Board | Thelevelofrisk theGroup chooses to accept, setmaterially inside capacity to preserve a management buffer. |
| Risk tolerance | Group ExecutiveRiskCommitee | Permissible variation around each appetite measure;breaching tolerance triggers escalation but is not itself a policy breach. |
| Risk limits | Group CRO/ALCO | Hardboundaries cascaded to divisions,desks,portfolios andcounterparties.A limit breach is a policy breach. |
| Triggers | Divisionalrisk functions | Early-warning thresholds set inside limits,prompting action before a limit is reached. |

## 8.2 Setting andreviewing appetite

Appetite is reviewed at least annually, in parallel with the strategic and financial planning cycle, s# that the plan and the appetite constraining it are agreed together rather than sequentially. The Group CRO recommends the statement, drawing on the risk profile, capital and liquidity position, stress testing results and the emerging risk scan. Out-of-cycle review is triggered by a material acquisition or disposal, a material regulatory change, a Critical-rated incident, or any breach of a Board-level appetite measure.

8.3 Qualitative appetite statements

| RISKCATEGORY | APPETITE | BOARDSTATEMENT |
|---|---|---|
| Credit risk | Moderate | Creditrisk is core to thebusiness,within a diversifiedportfolio anddisciplinedunderwriting.No appetitefor exposuresoriginated outsideapprovedcriteria. |
| Marketrisk | Lowtomoderate | Accepted insupportofclientfacilitationandprudentbalance-sheetmanagement.Noappetitefor proprietary directional risk-taking. |
| Liquidityand funding | Low | Aconservative liquidityposition capable of withstanding a severe,prolonged stress without recourse to extraordinary support. |
|  |  |  |
